content.title: Take a Free Online Course at Senar: Over 200 Options with Digital Certification, a Great Opportunity for Training in Various Agricultural Fields
content.text: Senar makes dozens of free online courses available from now on, with open enrollment on the Senar Play portal, aiming to train people from rural areas in various fields. This opportunity is directed at those looking to enhance knowledge in a flexible and accessible way. The initiative is available in the Distance Education (EAD) environment, allowing the public to enroll and start studying immediately, with certification at the end. All this happens through a free platform focused on agriculture and digital inclusion. Available Programs: What Does Senar Offer? The Senar Play portal has more than 200 free courses in areas such as agriculture, animal production, mechanization, environment, technology, and social promotion. In addition, registered users have access to videos, series, manuals, podcasts, and virtual tours, broadening the learning spectrum. Examples of Free Courses Offered by Senar The Senar catalog is vast, but some courses stand out for their applicability in the daily life of the field: 1. Precision Agriculture This course presents modern techniques that combine technology and management in agricultural practices. The student learns to use digital tools to monitor crops, reduce costs, and increase productivity, which translates into more efficiency and sustainability in the field. 2. Good Practices in Beef Cattle Farming Targeted at farmers and rural workers, the content addresses essential care related to nutrition, sanitary management, and animal welfare. The goal is to ensure higher meat quality, reduce losses, and improve the profitability of livestock activities. 3. Basic Computer and Internet Skills This course is ideal for those looking to take their first steps into the digital world. It teaches everything from safe internet browsing to the use of basic computer tools, facilitating access to new technologies and modern management of rural properties. How to Enroll and Start the Courses? To participate, interested individuals must access the portal and complete a free registration with their CPF and personal information. After registration, just select the courses with open enrollment, enroll, and start studying immediately. The entire process is online, with a study environment available 24 hours a day, including weekends and holidays. Access the Senar portal Advantages of Distance Education in the Field The EAD model from Senar, in addition to being accessible and free, allows students to study at their own pace, wherever and whenever they want. This modality is ideal for the rural audience, as it eliminates the need for travel and offers. Certification and Student Support Upon completing all stages, the student receives a digital certificate in PDF, with a digital signature, workload, CPF, and course details. Moreover, participants have access to tutors and monitors to clarify doubts during the educational process. Practical Functionality and Technical Support The online environment requires only a computer or mobile device with internet access, modern browser, JavaScript enabled, and headphones or speakers. The use is simple and accessible, even for technology beginners. Regional Highlights and Specific Free Courses Some courses have enrollment open until specific dates. For example, the EAD from Senar Goiás offers a free course on Artificial Intelligence in Pedagogical Practices until September 1, 2025. Recently, Senar/MS opened 35 free online courses, in areas such as environment, innovation in agriculture, and digital inclusion. Senar’s initiative with free courses and open enrollment on the Senar Play portal represents an important tool for transformation in the rural area. With flexibility, autonomy, certification, and qualified support, the program allows producers, workers, and other interested parties to enhance useful skills for the field, all without leaving home and at no cost.
